gaps.sentence: Come on, join ___ — it's easy once you start.
gaps.explanation: join in = take part in an activity others are doing.

gaps.sentence: Who is going to deal ___ the angry customer?
gaps.explanation: deal with = handle; deal in = trade.

gaps.sentence: She's taken ___ knitting to relax after work.
gaps.explanation: take up = start (a hobby, sport, activity).

gaps.sentence: A new proposal was put ___ at the meeting.
gaps.explanation: put forward = propose, suggest (an idea, plan, name).

gaps.sentence: Don't leave ___ any details in your report.
He loves showing ___ his new car to the neighbours.
gaps.explanation: show off = try to impress people with your abilities/possessions.
bring down = cause a government/person to lose power; reduce (prices).

gaps.sentence: The old cinema was knocked ___ to build a car park.
gaps.explanation: knock down = demolish a building; hit with a vehicle.
